title: membrane_evo cells stop dividing without the imposed death disks: the population freezes, so reproduction and selection both need imposed turnover
summary: membrane_evo_up and its identical-event twin membrane_evo run with p_death=0 (everything else identical, seeds 21 and 22, T=40000) form walled cells from noise that grow to fill space and freeze by t~10000 at 6-13 cells: 0-1 persistent splits per run against 5-14 with the disks on (seeds 21-23), and the K2 share no longer separates between up and twin (0.07 vs 0.32, 0.65 vs 0.50; with disks 0.78-0.93 vs 0.02-0.46). Division in this world is triggered by disk cuts and the space they free, so a route to C:autonomous-heredity that only replaces disk deaths by intrinsic identity deaths must also produce intrinsic turnover (deaths that free space and nutrient) or the population will stall.

finding.control: matched ablation p_death=0, same seeds, same identical-event RNG for flips
finding.result: persistent splits 0-1 (p_death=0, 4 runs) vs 5-14 (p_death=0.01, 6 runs); K2 share separation lost
